name: cr702_166_bargained_casts_the_exiled_card_free
why: Beseech the Mirror bargained: the sacrifice is an additional cost (CR 702.166a), and the found card, mana value 4 or less, may be cast without paying its mana cost as the spell resolves (CR 608.2g). Cast, it isn't put into the hand.
expect_order: Player A casts Beseech the Mirror
Player A casts Lightning Bolt without paying its mana cost
Lightning Bolt deals 3 damage to Player B
